<observation>
  <type>feature</type>
  <title>Added extraction consistency voting and bounded retry configuration</title>
  <subtitle>ExtractionConsistency now supports repeated tool traces, while AgentService integrates consensus results and application.yml configures attempts.</subtitle>
  <facts>
    <fact>backend/src/main/java/com/ablueforce/cortexce/service/ExtractionConsistency.java defines extraction consistency behavior across tool traces.</fact>
    <fact>backend/src/test/java/com/ablueforce/cortexce/service/ExtractionConsistencyTest.java adds 74 lines of coverage for extraction consistency behavior.</fact>
    <fact>backend/src/main/java/com/ablueforce/cortexce/service/AgentService.java adds ArrayList-based trace collection and replaces the direct LLM call with consistency-aware extraction flow.</fact>
    <fact>backend/src/main/resources/application.yml adds an attempts-per-tool-trace setting whose documented values include 1 for vote off and 3 for majority voting at 3x latency.</fact>
  </facts>
  <narrative>ExtractionConsistency was introduced as a service component, with a dedicated test suite covering its behavior. AgentService was updated to collect multiple tool traces and route extraction through the consistency mechanism, replacing the previous single direct LLM-call path. Configuration in application.yml exposes the attempts-per-tool-trace tradeoff, allowing voting to be disabled with one attempt or enabled with three attempts for majority-vote extraction at increased latency.</narrative>
